given: a Staff Member holding maintenance.report at a Property where maintenance is available
when: they report a problem about a room with a title and a priority
then: the request is new, numbered MT-n at that Property, names them as reporter and the room, and an audit record says so, in one transaction

given: two Properties, and two reports at one of them at the same moment
when: the requests are written
then: each Property counts from 1, and the two simultaneous reports get two different consecutive numbers rather than one refusal

given: a caller naming reported_by, reported_at or the number in an insert
when: it is written
then: refused with 42501: those columns are in no grant, and the database stamps them

given: a Staff Member whose role lacks maintenance.report
when: they report a problem
then: refused by the policy, nothing written, and the screen offers no New request button

given: the Property's maintenance capability is off or the Organization's Subscription is not active
when: a Staff Member with every permission reports, moves or reads
then: the write is refused by all five gates in the policy, and the board and the rail entry are absent

given: a Staff Member assigned to one Property
when: they read or write requests at another
then: nothing comes back and nothing is written, indistinguishable from a Property with no requests

given: a request at Property A
when: it names a Unit of Property B
then: refused by a composite foreign key: a request's Unit is at the request's Property

given: a request that names neither a Unit nor equipment
when: it is written
then: refused by a check constraint

given: a title shorter than 3 or longer than 200 characters after trimming, or details longer than 2000
when: it is written
then: refused by a check constraint; the form says which field

given: requests at a Property in every state
when: a Staff Member reaching the Property opens Maintenance
then: four columns — New, In progress, Waiting for parts, Done — each with its count; Done shows the last 30 days; cancelled requests are behind a filter; each card shows number, title, where, priority, assignee and out of order

given: a Staff Member holding maintenance.manage and a new request
when: they move it to In progress
then: it is in progress, stamped with when it moved, and the audit record names the state it left

given: a Staff Member who reaches the Property without maintenance.manage
when: they open the board
then: they see every request and no control that moves, assigns or cancels one; a forged move is refused by the policy

given: a request in progress
when: it is moved to In progress again, or the form is submitted twice
then: nothing changes and nothing fails

given: two managers looking at a new request
when: one moves it to Done and the other then moves it to In progress
then: the second move is refused as stale, names the state it is in now, and changes nothing: every move names the state the mover saw

given: an open request
when: it is cancelled with a reason of 3 to 200 characters
then: it is cancelled with that reason; without one, or with a reason on any other state, a check constraint refuses

situation: A done request is not cancelled
given: a done request
when: it is cancelled
then: refused: it was fixed; reopen it first

given: a done or cancelled request
when: a manager reopens it
then: it is new or in progress again, its cancel reason is cleared, and the audit record keeps what it was

given: a request and a Staff Member whose membership is active and who reaches the Property
when: a manager assigns it to them
then: it names them, and the audit record says who assigned whom

situation: Assign somebody who cannot see it
given: a Staff Member of another Organization, a revoked one, or one without reach to the Property
when: a request is assigned to them
then: refused by a trigger: an assignee reaches the request's Property

given: a request assigned to somebody whose reach is later taken away
when: the board is read
then: the request keeps the name, marked as no longer reaching the Property, and the picker no longer offers them

given: a request that can wait
when: a manager makes it urgent
then: it is urgent and audited; priority is one of urgent, this_week, can_wait

given: a manager
when: they update a request's Property, Unit, number or reporter
then: refused with 42501: a grant lists the columns an update may touch, and where it is and who reported it are not among them

given: any request
when: anybody deletes it
then: refused: there is no delete policy and no delete grant

given: a Staff Member with maintenance.report on the Rooms screen of a Property with maintenance
when: they choose Report a problem on a room
then: the request form opens with that room chosen

given: a Property with no requests
when: the board is opened
then: it says there are no requests at that Property and offers New request to whoever may report

given: a write refused by the database
when: the screen reports it
then: a translated message, the form kept as it was, and nothing claimed as done

given: Turkish, English and Arabic
when: the board, the forms and the audit log are read
then: every label, state, priority and audit action is translated, and Arabic mirrors the board

given: a new Organization
when: its shipped roles are read
then: every role holds maintenance.report; owner and manager hold maintenance.manage and maintenance.equipment; owner, manager, front desk and housekeeping hold maintenance.take_out_of_order

given: a busy board
when: a manager filters by priority, assignee or out of order
then: only matching cards show, with the counts of what is shown

given: a Staff Member holding maintenance.report and maintenance.take_out_of_order, and an available room
when: they report a problem and switch on take it out of order
then: the request holds the room, the room is out of order, and one transaction records both

given: an open request that does not hold its room
when: a Staff Member holding maintenance.take_out_of_order takes it out of order
then: the request holds the room and the room is out of order; the audit record names the request

given: a Staff Member holding maintenance.report only
when: they report with take it out of order forged on
then: refused as a whole and nothing written; the switch is not offered to them

situation: Blocking and out of order are different permissions
given: a Staff Member with maintenance.take_out_of_order and without accommodation.configure, and another the other way round
when: each writes the other's status
then: refused: blocked is written only with accommodation.configure and out_of_service only with maintenance.take_out_of_order, although one column holds both; the restrictive accommodation_units_status_by_permission policy says so

given: the command that takes a Unit out of order
when: it runs
then: the hold and the status are written in one transaction with the Unit's row locked, so a Unit is out of order exactly while a request holds it; no screen writes the status directly

given: a room let by the bed, taken out of order
when: a bed in it is offered for booking, booked, or checked in to
then: none of its beds is offered, a booking naming one is refused, and a check-in is refused by the trigger that reads the room above the bed

given: a bed taken out of order on its own
when: the room is booked
then: only that bed is unavailable; its neighbours are sold as before

given: a blocked Unit
when: a problem is reported about it
then: the report is written without a hold; taking it out of order is refused while it is blocked, and blocking a Unit out of order is refused too: each is entered from available only

given: a room with a Guest in house
when: it is taken out of order
then: the desk is shown the Guest and the day they leave and asked to confirm; confirmed, the room is out of order, the Guest stays, and checking them out still works

given: confirmed Reservations holding the room's coming nights
when: it is taken out of order
then: the desk is shown each one — reference, Guest, dates — and asked to confirm; nothing is cancelled or moved, and each stays confirmed

given: two requests holding the same room
when: one of them is returned to service
then: the room stays out of order until the other releases it too

given: two Staff Members, one taking a room out of order and one returning it through another request
when: both commit at once
then: the room's row is locked by each in turn, and the status the room ends with agrees with the holds that remain

given: a room taken out of order
when: an expected-back date is given
then: it is shown on the board and on Rooms; a date before the Property's today is refused, and a date that passes leaves the room out of order and marks it overdue rather than returning it

given: the setting returns a room when its request is done
when: a request holding a room is moved to Done
then: its hold is released; if no other request holds the room it is available, and unit.returned_to_service is published in the same transaction

given: the setting asks for a confirmation
when: a request holding a room is moved to Done
then: it is done and still holds the room; the card says so and offers Return to service to whoever holds maintenance.take_out_of_order

given: a request holding a room
when: it is cancelled
then: its hold is released as a return to service would release it

given: the setting says a returned room comes back dirty, clean or inspected, at a Property with housekeeping
when: the worker delivers unit.returned_to_service
then: the room's housekeeping status is what the setting says, or what it already was if that is worse (MT-S2-30), unless somebody changed it after the return; where housekeeping is not available nothing is written

given: a return already applied
when: the same event is delivered again
then: nothing changes

given: ranza_worker
when: it reads or writes maintenance tables directly, or calls the return function for another Organization's event or with no worker context
then: refused: it holds no grant on them and reaches housekeeping status only through the one function

given: a room returned to service while still broken
when: the request is reopened and taken out of order again
then: the room is out of order again, audited

given: a room taken out of order by mistake
when: it is returned to service with an optional note
then: it is available, and the audit record keeps the note

given: an Organization with no Maintenance setting
when: it is read
then: an assignee is not required, a room returns when its request is done, and it returns dirty; a Property override with no value follows the Organization default

given: a Staff Member holding maintenance.manage with reach to one Property
when: they change the Organization default
then: refused: the default needs Organization-wide reach; they may override their own Property

given: done requests still holding rooms under confirmation
when: the setting is switched to return on done
then: they keep holding until confirmed; a setting decides what the next move does, never what is already held

given: the setting requires an assignee and an unassigned new request
when: it is moved to In progress or Waiting for parts
then: refused by a trigger with a message that asks for an assignee

given: an Organization with a Maintenance default
when: a second default row is inserted
then: refused by a partial unique index

given: any change to the default or an override, including a reset
when: it is saved
then: an audit record names who changed it, where, from what and to what

given: a room out of order
when: Rooms is read
then: it reads Out of order, with the expected-back date and the request's number, in the danger tone the front desk uses for it

given: an arrival whose room is out of order
when: the desk opens Arrivals and presses check in
then: the row reads Out of order and check-in is refused with a message that says why, not a generic failure

given: a dirty room, and a setting that returns rooms inspected
when: it is taken out of order and returned at once
then: it comes back dirty: a room returns as the worse of its state — as app.unit_housekeeping_state reads it, dirty when a Guest has left since its status was set — and the setting's, so a repair never stands in for cleaning and nobody can take a dirty room out to have it read inspected; a room with no status counts as clean. Decided by the agent after the advisor's review; signed off by the product owner, Albaraa Zain, on 2026-09-24

given: a room taken out of order, and the database clock stepping back before it is returned
when: it is returned
then: the return is stamped no earlier than the hold it ends (greatest of now and since), so returned_after_taken holds and the return goes through; the worker still matches it to its event (20260916004900)

given: a Staff Member holding maintenance.equipment
when: they add an item with a name, a category, where it is — a Unit at the Property or a named place — a service interval in months and when it was last serviced
then: it is in the register, audited

given: an item
when: it names neither a Unit nor a place, or a Unit at another Property
then: refused: a check constraint needs one of them, and a composite foreign key keeps the Unit at the item's Property

given: a name of 1 to 120 characters, a category of 1 to 60, an interval of 1 to 120 months, a last-serviced date
when: an item is written outside them, or serviced in the future
then: refused; a future last-serviced date is refused by the module against the Property's today

given: items with and without an interval, serviced long ago, recently or never, with and without an open request
when: the register is read
then: fault when an open request names it; otherwise overdue after its next service date, due within 14 days of it, and working otherwise; an interval never serviced is due now; nothing is stored

given: an item
when: a Staff Member with maintenance.equipment changes its fields
then: it changes, and the audit record keeps what each field was; a last-serviced date the person left as the form showed it does not overwrite a service recorded while the form was open

given: an item no longer used
when: it is retired, then restored
then: retired, it leaves the register, the plan and the request form, a request raised against it is refused, and it keeps its requests and history; restored, it is back as it was

given: an item at the Property
when: a problem is reported about it, with or without a room
then: the request names the item; an item at another Property is refused by a composite foreign key

given: a Staff Member without maintenance.equipment
when: they open Equipment or write an item
then: they read the register and are offered no change; a forged write is refused by the policy

given: two identical boilers
when: both are added with one name
then: both are kept: names are not unique, the place tells them apart

given: any item
when: anybody deletes it
then: refused: there is no delete policy and no delete grant

given: a Property with no equipment
when: Equipment is opened
then: it says there is nothing registered and offers Add equipment to whoever may

given: items with a service interval
when: Service plan is opened
then: they are listed by next service date, overdue in the danger tone and due within 14 days in the warning tone, each saying how many days overdue, today or in how many days, from the Property's today

given: an item that is due and a Staff Member holding maintenance.report
when: they create a work order for it
then: a service request is reported against the item — urgent when overdue as the register means it, this week otherwise, so an item never serviced is this week — and the plan shows its number

situation: One open work order per item
given: an item with an open service request
when: a second work order is created
then: refused by a partial unique index; the plan shows the open one instead of the button

given: a service request for an item, and a Staff Member holding maintenance.manage whether or not they hold maintenance.equipment
when: it is moved to Done
then: the item's last-serviced date is the Property's today and its next service moves on, in the same transaction, audited

situation: A fault is not a service
given: a fault request about an item
when: it is moved to Done
then: its last-serviced date does not change

given: a done work order
when: it is reopened
then: the last-serviced date it wrote stays; a manager corrects the date on the item if the service did not happen, audited

given: no item with an interval
when: Service plan is opened
then: it says nothing is scheduled and how to schedule an item

given: a request and a Staff Member holding maintenance.manage
when: they record a cost and who did the work
then: the cost is whole minor units of the Property's currency and the vendor up to 120 characters; the audit record keeps the previous values

situation: A cost that is not one
given: a negative cost
when: it is written
then: refused by a check constraint; zero is allowed, for a repair that cost nothing

given: a request about a room and a Stay in it — in house, or departed with its Folio still open — and a Staff Member holding finance.post_charge
when: they charge that Guest an amount
then: a charge line is on that Stay's Folio, described with the request's number and title, the request lists it, and both modules audit it, in one transaction; only a charge posted in that transaction can be linked

given: the Stay's Folio is closed
when: the Guest is charged
then: refused by the Folio's own trigger, and nothing is linked

given: a manager without finance.post_charge
when: they charge a Guest
then: refused by the folio_lines policy; the button is not offered

given: a Property without billing
when: a request is read
then: no Stay is offered to charge

given: a request about a room let by the bed, or about equipment only
when: the charge form is opened
then: it offers the Stays in the room or its beds that are in house or have an open Folio, most recent first; a request about equipment only offers none

given: a damage charge posted by mistake
when: it is reversed on the Folio with a reason
then: the Folio holds the reversal line and the request shows the charge as reversed; nothing is edited or deleted

given: a Guest who broke two things
when: they are charged twice
then: both lines are posted and both are listed

situation: A charge while finance closes the Folio
given: a damage charge posted and not yet committed
when: a Staff Member holding finance.manage_folio closes that Folio
then: every closure takes the Stay's advisory lock, as check-out does (CO-S1-15): the closure waits for the charge and audits a balance that includes it; a charge arriving after the closure waits and is refused because the Folio is closed (20260916004800)

given: a renovation planned for next month
when: a room is to be taken out of order from a future date
then: deferred: out of order starts now and lasts until returned (decision 10); dated periods need availability to read a second table

given: a Resident in the Portal
when: they report a problem
then: deferred: needs a Resident's own policies over requests (ADR 0009)

given: a request
when: a photo is attached
then: deferred: there is no file foundation (roadmap Phase 1)

given: open urgent requests
when: Today is read
then: deferred: the Today dashboard's cards are not built

given: a repair that needs a part from a supplier
when: it is recorded
then: deferred: the vendor is free text here; a vendor register and parts stock belong to Procurement and Inventory

given: an item coming due
when: a day passes
then: deferred: the worker does not raise work orders yet; the plan's button does

given: a Reservation on a room taken out of order
when: the desk moves it to another room
then: out of scope: moving a Reservation is not built (roadmap, cancelling and amending); the warning lists it

given: an urgent request left alone
when: time passes
then: deferred: escalation belongs to Tasks (blueprint 5.17)

given: an Organization with technicians
when: it wants a role for them
then: out of scope: it composes one from the maintenance permissions (Staff slice 3); no role ships

given: a technician on the floor
when: they work their requests
then: deferred: the mobile maintenance mode of blueprint 4.7

given: a recorded cost
when: the period closes
then: deferred: nothing posts to Accounting (Phase 4)

given: a Guest asks the front desk to fix something in their room
when: a work order is raised from that request
then: deferred: Guest requests belong to Guest and Resident Services (blueprint 5.5), which is not started; until then the desk reports it from Rooms or the board, and that module will raise through maintenance's report command rather than write requests itself

situation: Out of order written around a hold
given: a Staff Member holding maintenance.take_out_of_order
when: they update a Unit's status to out_of_service directly
then: deferred: nothing holds the room and no screen can return it; a Maintenance migration could add a deferrable constraint trigger on both tables asserting at commit that a Unit is out_of_service exactly while an open hold exists (ADR 0032 accepts the gap today, MT-S2-05)

given: a Unit whose status is out_of_service
when: Rooms is read
then: resolved: Rooms reads Out of order with the request's number, in the danger tone Arrivals uses (rooms-view.tsx)

situation: A bed under a room out of order
given: a room out of order with beds under it
when: a bed is checked in to
then: resolved: app.unit_is_in_service() reads and locks the room above a bed (20260916004400)

given: a write setting a Unit out_of_service
when: it is made
then: resolved: the restrictive accommodation_units_status_by_permission policy decides which permission writes which status (20260916004400)

given: the block dialog
when: it is opened in Turkish or Arabic
then: resolved: the block dialog's placeholder is blockReasonPlaceholder in every locale

given: a room returning to service as dirty, clean or inspected
when: it is written
then: resolved: housekeeping_unit_status is on feat/housekeeping (PR #56), which this branch stacks on and which merges first
